description: List things in the world or an area, filtered, nearest first. Read only.
text: Pages: limit, offset, has_more; order nearest (default) or id.

options.prefab: Whole name, hash, or parts with * ('*Tank*Insulated*'); or a list.
options.text: find script: text a saved script's name or description holds.

thing.summary: any object: structures, devices, tanks, loose items, players, animals

name.description: Part of the shown or game name, any case.

labelled.description: Only things with a Labeller name.

runtime_type.description: Only things of this game class or one built on it ('Device', 'Pipe').

broken.description: true: only broken things; false: only whole ones.
broken.x-script: True: only broken things; False: only whole ones.

color.description: Only things showing this colour: a name or an index, as write paint takes it.

painted.description: true: only paintable things painted off their own colour; false: only those still in it.
painted.x-script: True: only paintable things painted off their own colour; False: only those still in it.

has_atmosphere.description: true: only things holding gas or liquid; false: only without.
has_atmosphere.x-script: True: only things holding gas or liquid; False: only without.

made_by.description: Only items the print log has from this maker (id, or part of its name).

made_since.description: Only items made at or after this game time (s); negative: that many seconds back.

location.description: ground, player, stored, built or world (players, animals).

radius.description: Metres around near; at most 1000 around a point, no limit around "player".
